title: DataLabs · RAG LC 214
description: RAG da LC 214/2025: contrato dos dados, gate de retrieval (lc05), gate de respostas (lc06), drift e custo. Toda série vem de audit.pipeline_step_runs; o piso de cada gate é gravado pelo próprio passo.

options.content: **Como ler.** Linha cheia = métrica da execução; tracejada = piso do gate (baseline − tolerância de 1 caso). Gate de pé = a linha cheia não cruza a tracejada. *Folga* = a menor distância até o piso. Redação do modelo muda entre execuções; veredito não (drift de texto é registro, não falha).

panels.title: Gate de retrieval (lc05)
panels.description: Último resultado do evaluate_retrieval: success = dentro do piso; failed = regressão.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Gate de respostas (lc06)
panels.description: Último resultado do generate_answers (subconjunto dev, ADR 0015).

targets.rawSql: SELECT status FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Folga mínima · retrieval
panels.description: Menor (métrica − piso) entre success@k, MRR e context_recall. Negativo = regressão. Vazio até a primeira execução que grava os pisos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEAST((m->>'fiscal_success_at_k')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_success_at_k')::float, (m->>'fiscal_mrr')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_mrr')::float, (m->>'fiscal_context_recall')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_context_recall')::float, (m->>'formal_success_at_k')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_success_at_k')::float, (m->>'formal_mrr')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_mrr')::float, (m->>'formal_context_recall')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_context_recall')::float) FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Folga mínima · respostas
panels.description: Menor (métrica − piso) entre refusal accuracy e citation recall, por grupo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEAST((m->>'fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float, (m->>'fiscal_citation_recall')::float - (m->>'floor_fiscal_citation_recall')::float, (m->>'formal_refusal_accuracy')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_refusal_accuracy')::float, (m->>'formal_citation_recall')::float - (m->>'floor_formal_citation_recall')::float) FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Respostas indevidas (false answers)
panels.description: Resposta mostrada a pergunta sem resposta na lei. É o erro que as 3 barreiras existem para impedir: teto = 0, sem tolerância.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((m->>'fiscal_false_answers')::float, 0) + COALESCE((m->>'formal_false_answers')::float, 0) FROM (SELECT metrics AS m, status FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) l

panels.title: Checks de dados (última rodada)
panels.description: Health checks lc214 que não passaram na última rodada.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('pass','skipped')) AS falhas FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND check_run_id = (SELECT check_run_id FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: 2 · Contrato dos dados (lc01 → lc04): cada passo, o que entregou
Último estado de cada passo
panels.description: skipped (exit 99) = a saída já estava atualizada para esta entrada e versão de código; não é falha.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.step AS passo, s.status, s.started_at AS inicio, ROUND(s.duration_s::numeric) AS duracao_s, s.rows_in AS entrada, s.rows_out AS saida, (SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs x WHERE x.pipeline = 'lc214' AND x.step = s.step AND x.status = 'success') AS ultimo_sucesso FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (step) * FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' ORDER BY step, started_at DESC) s ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['extract_source','parse_dispositivos','build_chunks','load_postgres', 'embed_chunks','golden_contract','evaluate_retrieval','generate_answers'], s.step)

panels.title: Health checks (última rodada)
panels.description: Paridade lei × serving, versão única, paridade chunks × vetores, mesma lei nos vetores, volume e frescor.

targets.rawSql: SELECT check_name AS check, check_type AS tipo, status, severity AS severidade, ROUND(observed_value::numeric, 3) AS observado, LEFT(message, 70) AS mensagem FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND check_run_id = (SELECT check_run_id FROM audit.data_quality_checks WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY check_name

panels.title: Volumes: dispositivos, chunks
panels.description: Provisões parseadas (≥ 4.000 pelo check) e chunks. Uma emenda da lei move estes números; uma queda sem emenda é parser quebrado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, step AS metric, rows_out::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step IN ('parse_dispositivos','build_chunks') AND status = 'success' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Roteamento e auto-citações (golden contract)
panels.description: Os rótulos do golden set ainda valem para a versão atual da lei? Roteamento exige 100%; auto-citações resolvidas ≥ 99%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS inicio, status, rows_in AS casos, (metrics->>'routing_accuracy')::float AS roteamento, (metrics->>'self_ref_rate')::float AS auto_citacoes FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'golden_contract' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 3 · Gate de retrieval (lc05): a resposta certa chega ao contexto?
Success@k
panels.description: Todas as provisões esperadas no top-k. Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_success_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_success_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_success_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_success_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_success_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_success_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_success_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_success_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: MRR
panels.description: Posição do 1º acerto (média do inverso do rank). Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_mrr')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_mrr' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_mrr')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_mrr' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_mrr')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_mrr' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_mrr')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_mrr' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Context recall
panels.description: Provisões esperadas no contexto montado para o LLM (orçamento de tokens). Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_context_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_context_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_context_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_context_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_context_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_context_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_context_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_context_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lacuna fiscal × formal (paired gap)
panels.description: Diferença de success@k entre a pergunta formal e a mesma pergunta em vocabulário fiscal. Mede o vocabulário que o retriever não cobre; informativo, não gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'gap' AS metric, (metrics->>'paired_gap')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'paired_gap' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hit@k e Recall@k (informativos)
panels.description: Não gated: ajudam a explicar uma queda de success@k.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal hit_at_k' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_hit_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_hit_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal recall_at_k' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_recall_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_recall_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal hit_at_k' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_hit_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_hit_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal recall_at_k' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_recall_at_k')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'evaluate_retrieval' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_recall_at_k' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 4 · Gate de respostas (lc06): responde certo, recusa quando deve, cita o que existe?
Refusal accuracy
panels.description: Acerto do veredito: responder quando há resposta e recusar quando não há. Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_refusal_accuracy' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_refusal_accuracy' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_refusal_accuracy' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_refusal_accuracy' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Citation recall
panels.description: Das respostas esperadas, quantas citam a provisão esperada. Gated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_citation_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_citation_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_fiscal_citation_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_fiscal_citation_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_citation_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_citation_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal · piso' AS metric, (metrics->>'floor_formal_citation_recall')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'floor_formal_citation_recall' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Citation validity
panels.description: Citações que existem na lei E estavam no contexto mostrado. Abaixo de 100% = o modelo citou o que não viu.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_citation_validity')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_citation_validity' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_citation_validity')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_citation_validity' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Respostas indevidas e recusas indevidas
panels.description: false_answers: teto 0 (gate estrito). false_refusals: o custo de ser conservador: onde a qualidade está perdendo hoje.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal false_answers' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_false_answers')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_false_answers' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal false_refusals' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_false_refusals')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_false_refusals' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal false_answers' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_false_answers')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_false_answers' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal false_refusals' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_false_refusals')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_false_refusals' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Veredito do modelo × decisão final
panels.description: Quanto o modelo diz que é respondível, antes das barreiras. Muito baixo = o modelo recusa tudo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal model_says_answerable' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_model_says_answerable')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_model_says_answerable' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal model_says_answerable' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_model_says_answerable')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_model_says_answerable' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Drift desde o baseline
panels.description: Registro, não gate. Veredito estável + texto reescrito = redação não reproduzível; flip de veredito = comportamento mudou.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'flips de veredito' AS metric, (metrics->>'verdict_flips')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'verdict_flips' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'textos reescritos' AS metric, (metrics->>'text_changed')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'text_changed' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'citação esperada mudou' AS metric, (metrics->>'cited_expected_changed')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'cited_expected_changed' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latência por frase (s)
panels.description: CPU, qwen2.5:3b, num_ctx 6144. Orçamento do DAG: 90 min para 11 frases.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal p50' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_latency_p50_s')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_latency_p50_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal p50' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_latency_p50_s')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_latency_p50_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'fiscal máx' AS metric, (metrics->>'fiscal_latency_max_s')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'fiscal_latency_max_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) UNION ALL SELECT started_at AS time, 'formal máx' AS metric, (metrics->>'formal_latency_max_s')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'formal_latency_max_s' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens por palavra (calibração do orçamento)
panels.description: O retriever estima 1,7 token/palavra; o lc06 mede com prompt_eval_count. Estimativa abaixo do medido = contexto estourando o num_ctx.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, 'medido' AS metric, (metrics->>'tokens_per_word')::float AS value FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status IN ('success','failed') AND metrics ? 'tokens_per_word' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Execuções do gate de respostas
panels.description: Inclui execuções skipped (--once: mesma impressão digital, nada a gerar).

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS inicio, status, ROUND(duration_s::numeric) AS duracao_s, metrics->>'variant' AS variante, metrics->>'decision' AS regra, (metrics->>'fiscal_refusal_accuracy')::float AS fiscal_recusa, (metrics->>'formal_citation_recall')::float AS formal_cit_recall, (metrics->>'verdict_flips')::int AS flips, LEFT(error_message, 60) AS erro FROM audit.pipeline_step_runs WHERE pipeline = 'lc214' AND step = 'generate_answers' AND status <> 'running' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20
